verdict.rationale: Evidence shows bulk-style operations exist but on the seller/merchant side rather than as an AI-native end-user action: sellers can upload a CSV feed of many products/variants in one import (up to 4GB, replace/update modes) and can 'bulk fulfill orders' via the List CheckoutSessions endpoint instead of handling each order individually. There's no evidence of an AI agent itself performing bulk purchases, bulk cart operations, or batched multi-item transactions on behalf of a user in one call. Missing for 10: agent-side bulk purchase/checkout APIs, evidence of an AI-native user (not backend seller tooling) invoking bulk operations across many items in a single agentic action.
